inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada is ramping up its discriminatory immigration and asylum crackdowns specifically targeting Nigerians and other migrants from the Global South right after Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, got royal assent on March 26, 2026. This is just another blatant move by wealthy nations like Canada to entrench structural racism and historical inequalities, slamming the door on vulnerable people while shielding the powerful from any real accountability. Instead of tackling the deep-rooted causes of displacement that stem from centuries of exploitation and global injustice, these policies put exclusion and border control first, exposing how little commitment exists to equity or protecting the rights of marginalized communities.
